g.text: Layer 17 roof: 1.540 mm radius · one 10.8 mm bottom arm and top arm per side · 4 mm/s.
First 16 layers are preserved. Enlarged circle-clearance views below refer to layers 11–16.

then the eight extended horizontal lines.

Gap definition: shortest XY distance from the line’s nozzle-centerline endpoint to the nominal Ø3.29 mm outer circle.
Width 0.30 mm · flow 1.4 · 25 mm/s on layers 11–16 · extrusion recalculated for each full extended line.
LAYER 17 ONLY — ONE UNINTERRUPTED BOTTOM-TO-TOP ROOF PATH PER SIDE
Each arm extrudes once, with no overlapping passes.
Their combined span is 7.566055 source units.
Right roof = exact reflection of left about X128.
Only the straight connector is trimmed by 0.001378 mm
to land exactly on both existing starting points.
Overlapping passes removed: each arm prints once.
15 deposition moves per side, including 2 true arcs.
Preview sampled directly from actual G-code arc centers.

Legacy filenames retained; actual total = 17 layers, final printed height = 1.020 mm.
LAYER 17 FINISHES — AFTER BOTH EXISTING CONTINUOUS ROOF PATHS
1 Left top → 2 Left bottom → 3 Right top → 4 Right bottom. Same Z1.020; no additional layer.
Start anchors: outer endpoints of the topmost /

Arc-end retractions retrace the same printed curve.
